failure.Authentik.false: Authentik is in front of this server, so the app needs its own sign-in to get through. Fill in the sign-in page fields under Advanced.
failure.Authelia.false: Authelia is in front of this server, so the app needs its own sign-in to get through. Fill in the sign-in page fields under Advanced.
failure.CloudflareAccess.false: Cloudflare Access is in front of this server, so the app needs a service token to get through. Fill in the sign-in page fields under Advanced.
failure.PasswordPrompt.false: This server asks for a username and password before the app can reach it. Fill in the sign-in page fields under Advanced.
failure.SignInPage.false: A sign-in page answered instead of the server. On public Wi-Fi, sign in to the Wi-Fi first. Otherwise fill in the sign-in page fields under Advanced.
failure.Authentik.true: Authentik didn't accept that username and app password.
failure.Authelia.true: Authelia didn't accept that username and password.
failure.CloudflareAccess.true: Cloudflare Access didn't accept the service token. Check that a Service Auth rule allows it.
failure.PasswordPrompt.true: The server's password prompt didn't accept that username and password.
failure.SignInPage.true: The sign-in page in front of the server didn't accept those details.

row.SignInPage.false: A sign-in page is in front of this server

hint.Authentik: Use your Authentik username and an app password. Make one in Authentik under your user settings, Tokens and App passwords.
hint.Authelia: Use your Authelia username and password. Authelia lets apps in only where its rule for this address is one factor.
hint.CloudflareAccess: Use a service token from Cloudflare Zero Trust, and add a Service Auth rule for it to this app's Access policy.
hint.PasswordPrompt: Use the username and password the server's proxy asks for.
hint.SignInPage: If the sign-in page takes a username and password from apps, enter them here. A page that only works in a browser can't let the app in: ask whoever runs it to let /rest/ through.
label.section: Sign-in page in front of the server
label.caption: For Authentik, Authelia, a proxy password or Cloudflare Access in front of the server.
label.saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
join.hint: If you don't have an account on this sign-in page, ask who invited you.
share.line: This server has a sign-in page in front of it, so people need an account there to open this link.
play.failure: A sign-in page answered instead of the server.
needsHttps: Use https for this address. The sign-in page password would cross the internet readable.
problem.bothPassword: Enter both the username and the password.
problem.bothToken: Enter both the Client ID and the Client Secret.
problem.colon: The username can't contain a colon.
problem.control: Remove the line break or special character from the sign-in page fields.
problem.reservedRow: That header is set by the sign-in page fields. Remove the row.
